label: rem:brane-boundary-remark
title: Archimedean locus of the brane boundary
html: In the archimedean realisation, the defining boundary \partial A_n corresponds to the geometric locus \partial \mathcal{S}_n = \{p \in \mathcal{S}_n \mid \ker(\mathfrak{d}_{n+1}|_p) \neq 0\} \subseteq \mathcal{S}_n, which exactly matches the degeneracy locus of the fibrewise descent map.
heading: Remark
